decisions.reason: Its reduced prominence after launch and delayed release suggest weaker traction, but the firm has already invested in and publicly committed to this specialized particle-therapy product, which makes management inclined to continue a bit longer.

A dedicated product page in both 2018 and 2019 indicates a visible and continuing commitment, and in a German niche measurement portfolio management would be reluctant to abandon such a recent launch quickly.
Because it remained fully presented after launch and fits the firm’s dosimetry line, sunk development costs and portfolio logic favor retaining it unless there is clear evidence of failure.
As a standard clinical ionization chamber, it appears close to the firm’s core business, so prior investment and strategic centrality make withdrawal unlikely.
This product strengthens a coherent dosimetry offering, and management guided by escalation of commitment would tend to preserve it absent strong proof that disappointing results are permanent.
Its continued standalone presentation and strong fit with the established measurement portfolio mean the firm is likely to keep supporting it rather than reverse course.
